# Bid the coats and the cracks, not the driveway special.

> Price a sealcoating job from square feet, coats, oil spots, crack fill, and the drive — not a cents-per-foot special. See gallons, walk-away price, and margin before you quote.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
